script:
"Angela what is the goal here.....? Are we going after your voice being taken or something else entirely? What exactly is your goal here with this stuff? Where is the evidence for any of it?"

"And first and foremost, I have you talking about killing yourself on recording with your kids screaming in the background and you’re sitting here trying to intimidate me and trying to make me not feel bad for teaching you that every action has a reaction. If you want me to hold the fuck back, shut the fuck up, you dumb bitch."

"I’m not canceling anything do you understand and when c p s gets hold of that video? Because of the proper mandatory reporter that I sent it to, that’s not my issue. Fuck off"

"And I don’t give a fuck if you can’t afford to pay the damages, I just want you under the stress that you’ve caused me."

"Send it to my parents Angela like you threatened ya loser"

"Maybe I should. Maybe I should stop talking about it. And just be about it, right? That’s the only way you’re gonna learn a lesson"
